name: KEI Industries Ltd
read: Guidance often revised and slipped (Sanand delay, margin cut); growth promises delivered, but margin and capex details lack verification.

events.label: FY27 revenue growth above 25%
events.quote: Now also I'm sure that our growth in this financial year will be more than 25% in financial terms in revenue terms.

history.quote: next year, we expect to achieve EBITDA margins of around 11% overall for the full year

history.quote: our guidance is still maintaining that we will be growing at a 25%-plus growth rate and our EBITDA margin will be close to 11%

revisions.quote: now we will be in the range of 11% to 12% operating margin for the coming year.

promises.actual: Q2 FY27 operating margin 9.97%; H1 FY27 EBITDA margin ~11%
promises.verdict: FY27 not over; Q2 margin 9.97% below 11-12% guidance, behind
